body.isa: ARM, position independent, integer only (no VFP/NEON)
body.control_note: enable=0 makes lz_block jump straight to the stock C05A7630 (same args, nothing touched); calls/out_bytes are statistics

veneers.placement: cave.claim("lz4fast.veneer", 8); must be within +-32 MiB of C05A7EE0 (cave arena C072E064..C072EFB4 is)

sites.name: decode
sites.only_caller: C05A7630 has exactly one caller (this bl) and no pointer references
sites.regs_relied_on: none beyond the stock ABI (r0 ctx, r1 out stream, r2 in stream, r3 FLG ptr)
sites.power_off_restore: declare as a 4-byte section with orig_word (SUP_BUILD_RULES §4)

arm_order: patch site (write, read back, C000E91C + C000EABC)
disarm_order: or just set enable=0 (data word, takes effect on the next call)
keep body until reboot (a decode may be inside it)
firmware_calls_from_body: tail jump to C05A7630 when disabled
conflicts_to_check: nobody else may patch C05A7EE0 or C05A7630 (integration line checks)
